records.notes: Visible forms show تَعۡلَمُونَ in most editions and يَعۡلَمُونَ in Shu'bah.
Visible forms differ in final hamza, madd, and ending presentation in تِلۡقَآءَ/تِلۡقَا; the evidence supports a form difference but not a confident semantic subtype.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh/Qalun show dagger-alif presentation تَبَٰرَكَ while the other editions show تَبَارَكَ.
Visible forms show بُشۡرَۢا in Hafs/Shu'bah and نُشُرَۢا or نُشُراَۢ in the other editions, a clear consonantal/lexical difference.
The visible lexical form is consistent; Warsh shows اٰمَنَ while the other editions show ءَامَنَ, an initial alif/hamza presentation difference.
